name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
description:
About This Game

Move with one hand. Aim with the other. Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a hardcore precision platformer that puts both to work: shoot mechanisms and move platforms with your floating cannon, then collect ability items to dash. Limited charges and different launch directions challenge you to connect each shot, jump, and landing into a route through the ruins. And after waking up underground, you have another question to answer: why are you a robot?

Created by a team bringing together a level designer and veteran Celeste player, a former miHoYo worldbuilding designer, and a former Sunborn technical-audio creator.

• Control ABYA and the floating cannon independently, combining movement, aiming, and mechanisms.

• Collect different items to chain dashes, launch along the line to a device, or dash backwards over long distances. Plan around their charges, directions, and landing points.

• Turn a first clear into a faster route, experimenting with shortcuts and ways to skip past obstacles.

• Cross a nuclear plant and a geothermal station, discovering subway stops, Chinese signs, and clues in a pixel-art underground world.

• Follow AI Deus and a trail of banter and dialogue to uncover who you are and why you became a robot.

Start with the jump itself: judge the gaps, avoid hazards, and time each takeoff and landing. Compact stages make every move count. Retry from checkpoints and turn a difficult stretch into a route you know by heart.

Shoot switches and move platforms with your floating cannon, then collect ability items and spend their charges to dash. Each item has its own dash count, direction, and distance. Plan your landing and connect your shots and dashes into a path through the stage.

Explore a nuclear plant and a geothermal station, reading the platforms and timing your dashes in each new setting. Different layouts give familiar items new uses as you observe, experiment, and find your way through.

ABYA wakes in the underground ruins to find a world without power and a body made of metal. Follow AI Deus through power stations and subway stops, piecing together banter, dialogue, and scattered records in search of clues to your identity.
short_desc: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.
